chunks.head: become of
chunks.gloss: (某人/某物)后来怎么样了、落得什么下场
chunks.note: what became of sb/sth = 某人/某物后来如何、下场怎样。此 become 不是'变成',而是'遭遇、落得'。多用于疑问。
chunks.ex_en: Nobody knew what became of the old sailor after the war.
chunks.ex_cn: 谁也不知道那个老水手战后怎么样了。

chunks.head: be off
chunks.note: be off = 离开、走掉(off 表'离去')。如 'I must be off' = 我得走了。文中枞树 'wanted to be off' = 老想着离开。

literal.note_cn: 此 off 表'离去',非'关闭'

chunks.ex_en: It's getting late — I must be off now.
